clauses.text: 3. Material - Shall be made from steel. Note -  Other requirements of washers shall be as specified in IS 5369 : 1975  General requiremens for plain washers and lock washers (first revision). SUMMARY OF IS 6610 : 1972 HEAVY WASHERS FOR STEEL STRUCTURES 2. Dimensions (in mm)
